titulo.alumno: Intermediate · Health and everyday symptoms: Listening comprehension

intro: T2 · Elementary · Understand the meaning and details of everyday written exchanges; understand notices, timetables and simple descriptive texts. Topic: Health and everyday symptoms. Focus: Listening comprehension (optional).

texto: Listening at doctor's surgeries and pharmacies: train your ear to recognise combined symptoms. When you hear «ฉันปวดหัวและมีไข้», identify «ปวดหัว» [bpùat-hǔa] with its low and rising tone, the link «และ» [lɛ́] and the presence of fever «มีไข้» [mii khâi]. You also tell apart instructions about when to take medication («หลังอาหาร», after eating).

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «หากมีอาการแพ้ยาหรืออาการผิดปกติ ควรรีบไปพบแพทย์ที่โรงพยาบาลทันที» express?

opciones.texto: If you have a drug reaction or any unusual symptom, go to the doctor at the hospital straight away.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «หากมีอาการแพ้ยาหรืออาการผิดปกติ ควรรีบไปพบแพทย์ที่โรงพยาบาลทันที» from the text.

opciones.texto: Washing your hands often prevents common respiratory infections.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Eating well-cooked food prevents gastrointestinal food poisoning.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the symptoms the patient describes. What exactly is she suffering from?

opciones.texto: A headache and a fever (ปวดหัวและมีไข้)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: «ปวดหัว» (headache) + «และ» (and) + «มีไข้» (have a fever).
Incorrect: it does not mention dental pain.
Incorrect: it does not mention muscle or joint injuries.
